summary: Strong PowerShell and GitHub Actions practices throughout. Workflow uses pinned actions (v4), least-privilege permissions, proper shell: pwsh specification, and explicit environment variables. Module has Set-StrictMode, comprehensive error handling, and excellent docstrings. Main maintainability issue: regex patterns for conventional commits are duplicated across Get-BumpType (lines ~67-75) and New-ChangelogEntry (lines ~125-132) — both match feat/fix/breaking prefixes identically. Should be extracted to constants. Minor: Report Result step in workflow (lines ~60-63) prints step outputs that were just written to $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT, slightly redundant but aids visibility. No comments in workflow explaining the two-job structure (test→bump-version). Overall, clean, testable architecture ready for CI/CD, but violates DRY on regex patterns.
